caption:
A wild dusky leaf monkey in Kaeng Krachan National Park, Thailand.

Its other name is the spectacled langur, after the white rings around its eyes. It lives high in the trees and eats mostly leaves.

Source: IUCN Red List, Trachypithecus obscurus.
